segments.text: Welcome to the walkthrough. I'll be your first speaker for this short demo, and I'll speak a few times so the tool has plenty to work with.
segments.speaker: Jordan Rivera (Tutorial)

segments.text: Hi everyone, I'm Priya, and I'll be the second voice joining the conversation today.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_01

segments.text: And I'm just here as a third speaker, no name needed, adding a little variety to the mix.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_02

segments.text: Notice how each of us keeps a steady and distinct tone, which is exactly what the system listens for.
segments.speaker: Jordan Rivera (Tutorial)

segments.text: The pipeline groups every speaker's turns, then asks a person to confirm who each voice really is.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_01

segments.text: Some voices it recognizes on its own, and the rest it leaves for you to decide with confidence.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_02

segments.text: That is the whole idea here. You always stay in control of the final label for every speaker.
segments.speaker: Jordan Rivera (Tutorial)

segments.text: Once the run finishes, you review the evidence and either accept a match or assign a new name.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_01

segments.text: It only takes a moment, and then your transcript reads with the right speaker on every line.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_02

segments.text: Thanks for following along. When you're ready, submit your own audio and try the full flow yourself.
segments.speaker: Jordan Rivera (Tutorial)
